CS_%Inh: Average of measures of normalized percent inhibition of the confirmation screen.
CS_StdDev: Standard deviation of the measures of the normalized percent inhibition.
CS_N: Number of measures of percent inhibition of the confirmation screen.
DR_Qualifier: Qualifier identifies if the resultant data IC50 came from a fitted curve or was determined manually to be less than or greater than its listed IC50 concentration.
DR_IC50: Inhibitor concentration in uM at 50% inhibition.
DR_LogIC50: Log10 of the IC50 in M concentration.
DR_ChiSquare: Measure of the goodness of the curve fit.
DR_Rsquare: Measure the success of the curve fit (square of the correlation between the response values and the predicted response values).
DR_N: Overall number of data points of percent inhibition that was used for calculations (includes all concentration points); in some cases a data point can be excluded as outlier.
DR_Comments: Addition comments based of visual inspection.
